blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Smart maritime infrastructures provide continuous access to heterogeneous sensing streams, enabling repeated experimentation, digital-twin development, and AI-based maritime services. However, sensing hardware alone is not sufficient for scene-specific model development: historical video streams must also be spatially indexed, contextualized, and reduced to informative subsets for annotation. This paper presents a frame-to-panorama localization and context-aware sampling pipeline for ship detection in historical PTZ maritime video lacking reliable pan, tilt, and zoom metadata. The main contribution is an end-to-end data-curation approach that recovers camera-view information from historical PTZ video and combines it with environmental context and visual diversity to construct compact, scene-specific training sets. Specifically, frames are localized on a reference panorama using SuperPoint and LightGlue, enriched with weather and solar-state metadata, and selected through diversity sampling to preserve variation across camera view and environmental conditions. A second context-aware stage targets under-represented distant-vessel cases near the horizon using tile-level visual embeddings and Gaussian Mixture Model clustering. Applied within the CMMI MDigi-I Smart Marina testbed, the proposed pipeline reduces 40,718 candidate frames to 220 images for annotation, corresponding to a 99.5% reduction. A YOLO26-m detector fine-tuned on this subset achieves a mean AP50 of 94.78% ± \pm 0.51% and a mean AP50–95 of 75.10% ± \pm 1.73% under sequence-grouped five-fold cross-validation. These results demonstrate that highly redundant infrastructure video streams can be transformed into compact, spatially and contextually diverse training sets for scene-specific detector adaptation while substantially reducing annotation effort.
blocks.zh: 智能的海洋基础设施提供不断获得不同传感器流的途径,从而能够进行重复试验、数字双向发展和基于人工智能的海事服务。 然而,仅靠感知硬件不足以进行场景特异性模型开发:历史视频流也必须在空间上进行索引,上下文化,并缩小成信息化子集进行注释. 本文在缺乏可靠锅、倾斜和缩放元数据的历史PTZ海洋视频中,介绍了船体探测的帧到剖面本地化和上下文感取样管道。 主要贡献是采用端到端的数据校准方法,从历史PTZ视频中回收相机视图信息,并与环境背景和视觉多样性相结合,构建紧凑,场景特异的培训集. 具体地说,框架是用SuperPoint和LightGlue的参考全景进行本地化的,并用天气和太阳状态元数据加以丰富,通过多样性采样加以选择,以保持摄像头和环境条件的差异。 第二种上下文感知阶段的目标是使用砖瓦级视觉嵌入和高斯混合模型集群,在地平线附近发现代表性不足的远洋案件。 在CMMI Mdigi-I Smart Marina试验床内应用,拟议的管道将40 718个备选框架减少到220个图像,用于注释,相当于减少99.5%。 此子集上的YOLO26-m探测器微调后,在顺序组合的五倍交叉验证下,平均AP50达到94.78%±\pm0.51%,平均AP50–95达到75.10%±\pm1.73%. 这些结果表明,高度冗余的基础设施视频流可以转化为紧凑、空间和背景多样的成套培训,以适应特定场景的探测器,同时大大减少注释工作。

blocks.en: Modern maritime research infrastructures are increasingly designed as operational testbeds where permanently stationed sensing assets support data collection, pilot execution, digital twinning, and the development of AI-enabled maritime services. Unlike short-term measurement campaigns, such infrastructures provide continuous access to heterogeneous data streams under real environmental and operational conditions. This lowers the barrier for developing and validating computer-vision methods, since models can be trained and tested on data collected from the same or similar physical environment in which they are expected to operate.
blocks.zh: 现代的海洋研究基础设施越来越多地被设计为可操作的试验台,永久放置的遥感资产支持数据收集、试点执行、数字配对以及开发人工智能辅助的海洋服务。 与短期计量运动不同的是,这种基础设施在实际环境和业务条件下提供不断获取不同数据流的途径。 这降低了开发和验证计算机视觉方法的障碍,因为模型可以从预期运行的相同或类似物理环境中收集的数据来培训和测试。

blocks.en: The data used in this work were collected within the CMMI MDigi-I Smart Marina infrastructure at Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus. The Smart Marina integrates RGB and thermal Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) cameras, LiDAR, underwater acoustic sensors, weather and air-quality monitoring nodes, and edge-to-cloud computational resources. The camera considered in this work is installed approximately 100 100 m above the water, providing a high-altitude view of the marina and surrounding maritime area, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . This setting provides a realistic testbed for scene-specific ship detection, with repeated camera poses, changing illumination, adverse weather, sea glare, variable zoom levels, and vessels appearing at very different scales. However, sensing hardware alone is not sufficient for adapting ML-based detectors to a specific deployment environment. The continuous PTZ video stream must first be converted into a compact and informative training set, which typically requires ground-truth annotation. Exhaustively annotating the available frames was impractical within the timeline of this work and would also be inefficient, since many sampled frames were highly redundant due to repeated camera poses and visually similar scene content.
blocks.zh: 这项工作所使用的数据是在塞浦路斯Ayia Napa Marina的CMMI Mdigi-I Smart Marina基础设施内收集的。 Smart Marina集成RGB和热Pan-Tilt-Zoom(PTZ)相机,LiDAR,水下声学传感器,天气和空气质量监测节点,边缘到云计算资源. 如图1所示,本工程中考虑的照相机安装在水面上方约100100米处,为船坞及其周围海域提供了高空视野。 这种设置为场景特定的船舶探测提供了现实的试验台,镜头的姿势反复出现,光照的变化,恶劣的天气,海光,可变的放大水平,以及出现在非常不同尺度的船舶. 然而,仅靠遥感硬件不足以使基于ML的探测器适应具体的部署环境。 连续的PTZ视频流首先必须转换成一套紧凑和内容丰富的培训,这通常需要地面真实的说明。 在这项工作的时限内,详尽地说明现有的帧是不切实际的,而且效率也低,因为许多取样的帧由于反复出现相机姿势和视觉上相似的场景内容而非常多余。

blocks.en: Although video-frame redundancy and efficient sampling have been explored in prior work [ 10 , 4 , 9 ] , less attention has been paid to practical infrastructure-specific pipelines that make redundant sensor streams ready for annotation and model adaptation when camera-view metadata are missing. In such settings, data reduction cannot rely only on uniform temporal subsampling. Instead, frames must be temporally indexed, enriched with contextual information, and related to the physical space observed by the sensors. This is particularly important for PTZ cameras, where visual content depends on view direction and zoom level. When reliable pan, tilt, and zoom values are unavailable, it becomes difficult to curate training and evaluation data sets that cover the full operational field of view. Similar challenges arise in other infrastructure settings involving movable or mobile sensing platforms, where visual observations must be mapped to a common spatial reference before they can support robust AI development or digital-twin integration.
blocks.zh: 虽然在先前的工作[10、4、9]中曾探索过视频帧冗余和高效采样,但较少注意针对具体基础设施的实用管道,这些管道使多余的传感器流在缺少摄像头元数据时可以进行注释和模型改造。 在这种情况下,数据的减少不能仅仅依靠统一的时间分样本。 相反,框架必须按时间编制索引,以背景信息丰富,并与传感器观测到的物理空间有关。 这对PTZ相机来说尤其重要,其视觉内容取决于视图方向和缩放水平. 在没有可靠的锅、倾斜和缩放值的情况下,就难以管理覆盖整个业务视野的培训和评价数据集。 在涉及可移动或移动感知平台的其他基础设施环境中也会出现类似的挑战,在这种环境中,视觉观测必须映射到共同的空间参考,然后才能支持强有力的AI开发或数字双倍集成。

blocks.en: In our installation, up to 90 % 90\% of the recorded footage originates from the camera’s default park position, producing strong spatial redundancy in the available data, as shown in Fig. 2 . Random frame sampling would therefore over-represent this dominant view and under-represent less frequent camera poses or environmental conditions. To make the infrastructure data usable for efficient annotation and model training, the available frames must first be mapped to a common spatial reference and then sampled according to both camera-view diversity and environmental context.
blocks.zh: 在我们的安装中,高达90%的90%的录制片段来自相机默认的公园位置,在可用数据中产生强大的空间冗余,如Fig所示. 2 (英语). 因此,随机帧采样会过多地代表这种占支配地位的视角,且不常见的照相机或环境条件较少。 为了使基础设施数据可用于有效的注释和模型培训,现有框架必须首先绘制成一个共同的空间参考,然后根据摄像头多样性和环境背景进行取样。

blocks.en: To address this bottleneck, we propose a frame-to-panorama localization and sampling pipeline for historical maritime PTZ video without reliable pan, tilt, and zoom metadata. Individual frames are localized on a manually constructed reference panorama using SuperPoint [ 3 ] and LightGlue [ 8 ] , yielding a panorama-coordinate representation of the camera view, including the projected frame center and an approximate view-scale measure derived from the projected frame coverage. These recovered view attributes are combined with weather observations and solar-state labels to support diversity sampling across camera view and environmental conditions. Because rare distant-vessel cases remained under-represented after this step, a second context-aware filtering stage isolates the horizon-facing maritime region, extracts tile-level visual embeddings, and uses Gaussian Mixture Model clustering to retain frames containing vessel-relevant open-water context. The resulting pipeline converts redundant smart-marina video streams into a compact subset for annotation and scene-specific detector training.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个瓶颈,我们提议在不可靠锅、倾斜和缩放元数据的情况下,对历史海洋PTZ视频进行帧到范围本地化和取样管道。 单个帧采用SuperPoint [3]和LightGlue [8] 的人工构建的参考全景图进行本地化,得出了相机视图的全景坐标表示,包括预测帧中心,以及从预测帧覆盖度中得出的一个大致的视图尺度度量. 这些回收的视图属性与天气观测和太阳状态标签相结合,以支持跨镜头视图和环境条件的多样性采样. 由于这一步骤后稀有的远洋流体案例仍然代表性不足,第二个上下文感过滤阶段隔离了地平线-直立海洋区域,提取了瓷砖级视觉嵌入物,并使用高斯混合模型集群来保留包含船只相关露水环境的帧. 由此产生的管道将冗余的智能马林纳视频流转换成紧凑的子集,用于注释和场景特定探测器训练.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are fourfold: 1. We demonstrate how a smart-marina infrastructure can be used as an AI model development testbed for scene-specific maritime perception. 2. We introduce and evaluate a frame-to-panorama localization pipeline that uses deep local features to map historical PTZ video frames to a reference panorama without relying on internal camera metadata. 3. We propose a sampling methodology that combines Kennard-Stone diversity sampling, weather and lighting metadata, and GMM-based context discovery for distant vessels near the horizon, reducing the data volume by 99.5 % 99.5\% . 4. We manually annotate the selected subset of 220 images and use it to fine-tune an NMS-free YOLO26-m detector. Sequence-grouped five-fold outer cross-validation yields 94.78% ± 0.51% AP50 and 75.10% ± 1.73% AP50–95.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献有四方面: 1. 我们示范如何利用智能海洋基础设施作为场景特定海洋感知的AI模型开发试验台。 2. 我们引入并评估一个帧到范围本地化管道,该管道使用深厚的局部特征,将历史的PTZ视频帧映射到参考全景,而无需依赖内部相机元数据. 3. 我们建议采用取样方法,将Kennard-Stone多样性取样、天气和照明元数据以及远洋船只基于GMM的上下文发现结合起来,将数据量减少99.5%(99.5)。 4. 我们手动对220个图像的选定子集进行注释,并用它来微调无NMS的YOLO26-m探测器。 序列组合5倍的外部交叉验证产量 94.78%±0.51%AP50和75.10%±1.73%AP50-95.

blocks.en: We demonstrate how a smart-marina infrastructure can be used as an AI model development testbed for scene-specific maritime perception.
blocks.zh: 我们示范如何将智能海洋基础设施用作人工智能模型开发试验台,用于特定场景的海洋认知。

blocks.en: II Methods
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: The original data set was collected from a PTZ CCTV camera installed approximately 100 100 m above Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus, providing a high-altitude view of the marina and surrounding maritime area. Recordings were collected between 1 August 2025 and 10 January 2026 and were automatically saved when activity was detected in the scene or when the camera was manually controlled by an operator. One frame was extracted per minute. The resulting frames did not include reliable pan, tilt, zoom, weather, or lighting metadata. We note that in this work we used data frames recorded during the daylight (based on the solar telemetry metadata we describe in following subsections) which constituted the largest portion of the original data ( 40,718 40,718 out of 64,000 64,000 frames).
blocks.zh: 最初的数据集是从安装在塞浦路斯Ayia Napa Marina上方约100米处的PTZ闭路电视摄像机中收集的,提供了对码头和周围海域的高空观测。 2025年8月1日至2026年1月10日之间收集了录音,当现场检测到活动或相机由操作员手动控制时自动保存. 每分钟提取一个框架。 由此产生的框架不包括可靠的锅、倾斜、放大、天气或照明元数据。 我们注意到,在这项工作中,我们使用了日光期间记录的数据框架(根据我们在以下各小节中描述的太阳遥测元数据),这些数据占原始数据的最大部分(64 000个框架中的40 718个,40 718个)。

blocks.en: II-A Camera-view recovery
blocks.zh: II-A 摄像头恢复

blocks.en:
To assign each frame a spatial reference, we constructed a panorama using Adobe Photoshop [ 1 ] by manually stitching sequential, non-magnified frames covering the camera’s operational field of view. This panorama served as the common coordinate system for frame-to-panorama localization. For each video frame, SuperPoint [ 3 ] was used to extract local keypoints and descriptors from both the frame and the panorama, while LightGlue [ 8 ] was used to establish feature correspondences. A homography was then estimated from the matched points using USAC-MAGSAC [ 2 ] , and the frame centre was projected onto the panorama coordinate system (an example is visualized in Figure 1 ). This produced the projected frame centre and the projected frame coverage, with the latter used as an approximate view-scale measure (i.e. depth of magnification). For each localized frame, we also stored the mean and median LightGlue confidence, the number of geometric inliers, and the projected coverage area. Because the panorama is used for feature-based localization rather than pixel-level alignment, minor stitching seams and local geometric distortions can be tolerated provided that sufficient consistent correspondences remain in the overlapping region. This is supported by the robustness of SuperPoint features to homographic transformations [ 3 ] , the demonstrated performance of SuperPoint–LightGlue for homography estimation under viewpoint and illumination changes [ 8 ] , and the use of USAC-MAGSAC to reject geometrically inconsistent correspondences during robust model estimation [ 2 ] . Sensitivity nevertheless increases when highly zoomed frames overlap primarily with a stitching seam or locally distorted region, where too few consistent matches may remain for reliable homography estimation.
Minor coordinate variations primarily affect frames close to spatial-bin boundaries and are unlikely to substantially alter the subsequent multi-feature diversity selection.
blocks.zh:
为了给每个帧指定一个空间参考,我们用Adobe Photoshop[1] 构建了一个全景图,方法是手动缝合顺序的、非放大的帧,覆盖相机的操作视野。 这个全景表作为框架到泛景区本地化的共同坐标系统. 对于每个视频帧,SuperPoint [3] 用于从帧和全景中提取本地键点和描述符,而LightGlue [8] 则用于建立特征对应. 然后,使用USAC-MAGSAC[2]的对应点对图谱进行了估算,并将框架中心投射到全景坐标系统(一个可视化的例子见图1)。 由此产生了预测的帧中心和预测的帧覆盖,后者用作近似视图尺度的测量(即放大深度). 对于每个局部框架,我们还存储了LightGlue的平均值和中位值,几何插座的数量,以及预测的覆盖面积. 由于全景用于基于特征的本地化而非像素级对齐,因此只要重叠区域中仍然保留足够的一致的函文,小缝合和局部几何扭曲就可以被容忍. 这一点得到以下因素的支持:SuperPoint特性对同位素转换的强性[3]、SuperPoint-LightGlue在视线和光照变化下进行同位素估计的示范性表现[8],以及使用USAC-MAGSAC在强性模型估计中拒绝几何不一致的函证[2]。 然而,当高度缩放的帧主要与缝合区或局部扭曲区重叠时,敏感性会提高,因为对于可靠的图谱估计来说,这些区域可能仍然很少保持一致的匹配。
微坐标变化主要影响靠近空间-宾边界的帧,不太可能大幅度改变随后的多地貌多样性选择.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Frame-to-panorama localization performance comparison between the proposed SuperPoint-LightGlue pipeline and the traditional SIFT-FLANN baseline. The task is evaluated as spatial-bin classification over the reference panorama.
blocks.zh: 表格 一:拟议中的SuperPoint-LightGlue输油管与传统的SIFT-FLANN基线之间的框架-泛管本地化性能比较. 该任务被评价为比参考全景的空间-宾分级.

blocks.en: II-B Metadata enrichment and diversity sampling
blocks.zh: 二-B 元数据浓缩和多样性抽样

blocks.en: To enrich each image with environmental context, we integrate historical weather data and solar telemetry. For each image frame, the corresponding metadata includes the nearest hourly weather observation, provided that the weather timestamp is within 1 hour of the image timestamp, together with a solar-state label. The solar state is categorized as day, night, or transition based on the image timestamp relative to sunrise and sunset. A 30-minute buffer is applied around both sunrise and sunset: timestamps clearly between sunrise and sunset are labelled as day, timestamps clearly outside this interval are labelled as night, and timestamps falling within the buffer periods are labelled as transition. The transition category therefore captures the periods during which illumination changes from night to daylight or from daylight to night.
blocks.zh: 为了用环境来丰富每个图像,我们综合了历史天气数据和太阳遥测。 对于每个图像框架,对应的元数据包括最近的小时天气观测,条件是天气时标在图像时标的1小时内,加上一个太阳态标签. 太阳状态根据相对于日出和日落的图像时间戳分为昼夜或过渡. 日出和日落前后都采用30分钟的缓冲:日出和日落之间明显的时间戳被标记为白天,在这一间隔之外明显的时间戳被标记为夜间,属于缓冲期的时间戳被标记为过渡. 因此,过渡类别包括照明从夜间到白天或从白天到夜晚的变化。

blocks.en: The enriched frame pool was then sampled to reduce redundancy while preserving diversity across camera pose and environmental conditions. First, frames were stratified into equal-width bins along the recovered horizontal panorama coordinate. From each bin, up to n n images were selected. If a bin contained fewer than n n images, all images were retained. Otherwise, the Kennard-Stone algorithm [ 7 , 6 ] was applied within the bin to Z-score normalized features to select a representative subset in a feature space defined by weather, vertical panorama coordinate, and projected frame coverage. This stage reduced the localized candidate set from 40,718 40,718 to 2,402 2,402 images, corresponding to a 94.1 % 94.1\% reduction.
blocks.zh: 然后对浓缩框架池进行取样,以减少冗余,同时保持相机姿势和环境条件的多样性。 首先,框架沿着回收的横向全景坐标分层成等宽的箱。 从每个垃圾桶中选择了最多 n 的图像 。 如果一个 bin 包含的图像少于 n n,则所有图像都被保留. 否则,Kennard-Stone算法[7,6]在bin内被应用到Z-score常态特征上,在天气,垂直全景坐标,以及预测帧覆盖度定义的特征空间中选择一个代表性子集. 这一阶段将本地化的候选者从40,718,40,718人减少到2,402,2,402人,相当于94.1%的94.1%。

blocks.en: II-C Context-aware sampling
blocks.zh: II-C 了解背景的取样

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Examples of GMM clusters obtained from tile-level visual embeddings. The left cluster contains vessel-relevant tiles, while the right cluster contains visually similar but non-relevant structures such as waves, masts, and breakwater regions.
blocks.zh: 图3:从瓦片级视觉嵌入中获取的GMM集群实例. 左组装有与船只有关的瓦片,右组装有视觉上相似但无关的结构,如波浪、桅杆和防波堤区域。

blocks.en: Following diversity sampling, a context-aware filtering step was applied to prioritize frames containing small maritime vessels in the open-water horizon outside the marina. Because frames were captured from different viewing directions and zoom levels, a lightweight YOLO11-n detector was trained to identify the horizon-facing maritime region, and each frame was cropped to this region of interest.
blocks.zh: 在进行多样性取样之后,采用了一种了解背景的过滤步骤,以优先确定船坞外露天水域内载有小型海上船只的船架。 由于帧是从不同的视野方向和放大水平捕捉到的,因此训练了一种轻量级的YOLO11n探测器来识别地平线的海洋区域,每个帧被裁剪到这个感兴趣的区域.

blocks.en: To preserve detail for distant-vessel discovery, each cropped region was divided into overlapping 192 × 192 192\times 192 pixel tiles with 10 % 10\% overlap in both dimensions, retaining edge tiles with a minimum size of 64 64 pixels. Tile-level predictions and visual embeddings were extracted using an ATSS-SwinL-DyHead model, which was found to produce features more sensitive to small distant boats than YOLO11 during preliminary experiments. Since the model showed high recall but low precision, only tiles predicted as boat were retained for clustering. Their embeddings were reduced with PCA while preserving 90 % 90\% of the variance, and a full-covariance Gaussian Mixture Model was fitted to the reduced feature space, with the number of components selected using the Bayesian Information Criterion. Frames were retained if at least one tile belonged to a vessel-relevant cluster, allowing visually similar non-relevant structures such as waves, buoys, masts, and breakwater regions to be filtered out. Figure 3 illustrates examples of GMM clusters corresponding to vessel-relevant tiles and visually similar non-relevant structures such as waves, masts, and breakwater regions. This stage further reduced the data set from 2,402 2,402 to 220 220 images.
blocks.zh: 为了保存远洋贝壳发现的细节,每个栽培的区域被划分为重叠的192×192\times192像素瓦片,两个维度重叠率为10%~10%,保留边缘瓦片,最小尺寸为6464像素. 利用ATSS-SwinL-Dyhead模型提取了图层的预测和视觉嵌入,在初步实验中发现该模型产生的特征比YOLO11更敏感。 由于模型显示高召回度但精度低,因此只保留了预计为船组的瓦片. 它们的嵌入在CPA中被缩小,同时保留了90%的90%的差值,一个全相变的高斯混合模型被安装在缩小的特征空间上,其中使用贝叶斯信息标准选择的组件数量. 如果至少有一块瓷砖属于一个与船只有关的组群,则框架被保留下来,这样可以过滤出类似视觉的非相关结构,如波浪、浮标、桅杆和防波堤区域。 图3显示了与船舶相关的瓦片和视觉上相似的非相关结构,如海浪、桅杆和防波堤区域对应的GMM群的例子。 这一阶段进一步将数据集从2,402,2,402个图像减少到220个图像.

blocks.en: II-D Annotation and model training
blocks.zh: 二-D 注释和示范培训

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Example of a manually curated segmentation annotation used to create object-detection labels. The annotation protocol focuses on visible vessel structures while excluding thin or ambiguous elements such as masts and railings.
blocks.zh: 费格。 4:用于创建对象检测标签的手动编解分解注释示例. 注释协议侧重于可见的船体结构,同时排除桅杆和栏杆等薄薄或模糊的元素.

blocks.en:
The final dataset comprised 220 images containing 4,017 vessel bounding boxes; 208 images contained at least one labeled vessel and 12 contained no labeled vessels. Performance was evaluated using YOLO26-m [ 5 ] , the medium-sized variant of the Ultralytics YOLO26 object-detection architecture, comprising 20.4 million parameters. The standard YOLO26-m architecture was used without architectural modifications. Model performance was evaluated using five-fold outer cross-validation. To prevent leakage between temporally related frames, the images were grouped into 182 acquisition sequences derived from their recording identifiers, and all frames from the same sequence were assigned to the same fold. Each outer fold contained 44 images. In each run, 158 images were used for training, 18 for internal validation and checkpoint selection, and 44 exclusively for outer-fold evaluation. Consequently, every image was evaluated exactly once by a model that had not used it for training or model selection.
Each fold was initialized from the same pretrained YOLO26-m checkpoint and trained for up to 500 epochs at an input resolution of 1280 × 1280 pixels, using a batch size of 16, cosine learning-rate scheduling, automatic mixed precision, and early stopping with a patience of 50 epochs. The data-partition and training seeds were fixed at 42, and all folds used identical hyperparameters. The checkpoint with the best internal-validation performance was evaluated on the corresponding outer fold.
blocks.zh:
最终数据集包括220幅图像,其中装有4 017个船装边框;208幅图像至少装有一艘船标,12幅装有无船标。 性能评价使用YOLO26-m [5],是超解YOLO26对象检测架构的中型变体,包含2040万个参数. 标准的YOLO26-m建筑未经建筑修改而使用. 模型性能通过五倍外跨验证来评价. 为了防止时间相关帧之间的渗漏,这些图像被组合成182个从记录识别器中衍生出来的获取序列,来自相同序列的所有帧被分配到相同的折叠. 每个外侧折叠都包含44幅图像. 在每次运行中,有158幅图像用于培训,18幅用于内部验证和检查站选择,44幅专门用于外部评价。 因此,每个图像都由一个没有用于培训或模型选择的模型准确评估一次。
每个折叠由同一预训的YOLO26-m检查点初始化,在1280×1280像素的输入分辨率下对最多500个历段进行了训练,采用16个批量大小,余弦学习率排程,自动混合精度,早期以50个历段的耐性停止. 数据分区和训练种子固定在42个,所有折叠都使用了相同的超参数. 对具有最佳内部验证性能的检查站进行了相应的外侧折面评价。

blocks.en: III Results & Discussion
blocks.zh: 三. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: III-A Frame-to-panorama localization
blocks.zh: III-A 框架到全景本地化

blocks.en: To quantitatively and qualitatively evaluate the mapping between image frames and the reference panorama, we compared our method against a traditional baseline. The proposed pipeline uses SuperPoint features paired with LightGlue matching, while the traditional baseline relies on SIFT features matched via the Fast Library for Approximate Nearest Neighbors (FLANN).
blocks.zh: 为了从数量和质量上评估图像框架和参考全景之间的绘图,我们把我们的方法与传统的基线进行比较。 拟议的管道采用与LightGlue配对的SuperPoint特性,而传统的基线依赖于通过近邻快库(FLANN)配对的SIFT特性.

blocks.en: To establish a quantitative benchmark, evaluation was conducted on video frames captured during daytime conditions. The evaluation set was structured by partitioning the horizontal panorama coordinate into 20 20 equal-width spatial bins. To ensure a balanced distribution, up to 100 100 images were sampled from each bin. Ground-truth labels were assigned manually by cross-referencing each sampled frame with the corresponding bin range on the reference panorama. This formulation allowed frame-to-panorama localization to be evaluated as a discrete spatial-bin classification problem.
blocks.zh: 为了确定量化基准,对白天条件下的录像框进行了评价。 通过将横向全景坐标划分为20个等宽空间箱来构建评价集. 为了确保分布平衡,从每个垃圾箱中抽取了多达100幅图像。 地面真实的标签是通过对每个抽样框架的交叉参考,在参考全景上与相应的宾场范围进行人工分配的。 这种配方使得帧到泛素本地化被评价为一个离散的空间滨分类问题.

blocks.en: As summarized in Table I , the SuperPoint+LightGlue pipeline significantly outperforms the traditional SIFT+FLANN baseline across all metrics, achieving a global accuracy of 87.36 % 87.36\% compared to the baseline’s 12.34 % 12.34\% .
blocks.zh: 如表一所示,SuperPoint+LightGlue输油管在所有指标上大大超过了传统的SIFT+FLANN基线,全球精度达到87.36% 87.36%,而基准为12.34 % 12.34%。

blocks.en: A qualitative analysis of the failure modes reveals distinct behaviors between the two approaches. The deep learning pipeline predominantly fails on highly zoomed-in frames. In these scenarios, the limited field of view reduces the number of identifiable keypoints, preventing the robust estimation of a homography matrix between the frame and the reference panorama. Conversely, under these identical conditions, the traditional SIFT+FLANN approach frequently produces a match; however, these matches are typically inaccurate, as shown in the top row of Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: 对失败模式的定性分析揭示了两种方法之间的不同行为. 深层学习管道主要在高度放大的框架上失败。 在这些假想中,有限的视野会减少可识别的关键点数量,从而无法对帧与参考全景之间的图谱矩阵进行有力的估计. 相反,在这些相同条件下,传统的SIFT+FLANN方法经常产生匹配;然而,如图5的上行所示,这些匹配通常不准确。

blocks.en: In contrast, instances where the deep learning model fails on zoomed-out frames are rare.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,深层学习模式在缩放框架上失败的情况很少见.

blocks.en: Finally, the middle example of Figure 5 highlights a common scenario where the deep learning pipeline successfully registers the frame but the traditional pipeline fails. These cases are primarily attributed to extreme illumination discrepancies between the query frame and the reference panorama, showcasing the robust feature representation capabilities of the learning-based approach over handcrafted descriptors under variable lighting conditions.
blocks.zh: 最后,图5的中间例子突出了一种常见的情况,即深层学习管道成功登记了框架,但传统管道失败。 这些案件主要归因于查询框架和参考全景之间的极端照明差异,显示了基于学习的方法在可变照明条件下相对于手动描述符的强烈特征表现能力.

blocks.en: Across the five outer folds, AP50 was 94.78% ± 0.51% and AP50–95 was 75.10% ± 1.73% (mean ± sample SD). The fold-level AP50 values were 94.85%, 95.00%, 95.27%, 93.92%, and 94.86%, corresponding to a range of 93.92%–95.27%. The two-sided 95% fold-level Student-t interval for mean AP50 was 94.15%–95.41%. Mean precision, recall, and F1-score were 94.95% ± 1.06%, 89.68% ± 1.43%, and 92.23% ± 0.70%, respectively. The small AP50 standard deviation and narrow range indicate that performance was stable across partitions and was not attributable to a fortunate 90%/10% split.

The proposed pipeline enabled the selection of a compact annotation set from a large and redundant infrastructure video stream. The resulting 220 220 annotated images captured different parts of the marina under varying camera views and environmental conditions, supporting scene-specific detector adaptation with substantially reduced annotation effort. This demonstrates how the Smart Marina infrastructure can be converted from a continuous sensing environment into an actionable AI model development testbed.
blocks.zh: 拟议管道使得能够从大型和多余的基础设施视频流中选择一套紧凑的说明。 由此产生的220幅附加说明的图像在不同的摄像头和环境条件下捕捉了船坞的不同部分,支持了场景特异性的探测器改造,并大大减少了注释工作。 这表明Smart Marina基础设施如何从连续的感知环境转化为可操作的AI模型开发测试床。

blocks.en: The current trained model sometimes fails to detect larger vessels that were not present in the training set, vessels under extreme sun glare, and ships in highly zoomed-in frames where the vessel occupies ≥ 50 % \geq 50\% of the image and is truncated by the frame boundary. These limitations can be addressed by including more examples with extreme zoom levels, stronger glare, truncated vessels, and a wider range of vessel types and sizes. Future work will use these observed failure cases to guide subsequent data collection and annotation rounds within the Smart Marina infrastructure. Generalizability across marina-like environments will also be explored.
blocks.zh: 目前训练有素的型号有时无法探测到没有在训练场的大型船只、在极端太阳光下的船只和在高度放大的船框中船只,因为船只占据了图像的50%\ geq 50%,并被框架边界截断。 可以通过增加极端放大水平、更强光度、短流船只和范围更广的船只类型和尺寸的例子来解决这些限制。 今后的工作将利用这些观察到的故障案例指导Smart Marina基础设施内随后的数据收集和注释回合。 还将探讨类似码头的环境的通用性。

blocks.en: Future work will use the observed failure cases to guide subsequent data collection and annotation rounds within the Smart Marina infrastructure. In addition, the current manual Photoshop-based image-stitching step will be replaced by automated image-stitching frameworks, reducing manual intervention and improving the scalability and reproducibility of the data preparation pipeline. Moreover, the generalizability of the proposed approach across other marina-like environments will be explored.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将利用观察到的故障案例指导Smart Marina基础设施内随后的数据收集和注释回合。 此外,目前的基于Photoshop的图像刻录步骤将被自动化图像刻录框架所取代,减少人工干预,提高数据准备管道的可扩展性和可复制性. 此外,将探讨拟议办法在其他类似码头的环境中的通用性。
